# I. Overview {#i.-overview}

## 1\. User Requirements {#1.-user-requirements}

### 1.1 Actors {#1.1-actors}

| \# | Actor | Description |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Guest | Unregistered visitor. Can view novels, read free chapters, search, and register an account. |
| 2 | Member | Registered user. Can save reading progress, manage personal bookshelf, top-up coins, purchase chapters, rate, and comment. |
| 3 | Staff | Editor & moderator. Manages content (novels, chapters), categorizes novels, handles violation reports, and sends notifications. |
| 4 | Admin | System administrator. Manages categories, audits transactions, configures the system, manages users and assigns roles. |
| 5 | Google Service | External OAuth2 identity provider. Authenticates guests and provides basic profile data for seamless login and automatic account creation. |
| 6 | Cloud Storage Service | External file hosting service \- Cloudinary. Responsible for securely storing, managing, and serving user-uploaded media files such as user avatars and novel covers. |
| 7 | VNPay Payment Service | External payment gateway. Processes secure online monetary transactions for Coin top-ups and sends IPN (Instant Payment Notification) webhooks to update the system upon payment success or failure. |

| UC-50 | User Administration | Ban/Enable User | Ban or re-enable user accounts that violate community terms. |
| UC-51 | Wallet & Payments | Audit Transactions | Audit all balance fluctuations including VNPay deposits and Coin usage. |
| UC-52 | System Administration | Configure System | Set exchange rates, system contacts, terms of use, and web themes. |

### 2.4 Non-UI Functions {#2.4-non-ui-functions}

| \# | Feature | System Function | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | Authentication & Security | Mail OTP Dispatcher Service | Asynchronously generates and sends OTP security codes via email (@Async) for both account registration verification and password reset recovery. |
| 2 | Authentication & Security | Session & Cookie Sanitizer | Automatically invalidates user sessions and clears security cookies upon logout or token expiration. |
| 3 | Reader Experience | Reading Progress Auto-Sync | Periodically auto-saves reading positions and calculates progress percentage in the background while reading. |
| 4 | Reader Experience | Text-to-Speech Processing Service | Converts text chapter content into audio streams for the Audio Reader feature without rendering UI. |
| 5 | Discover Novels | Leaderboard Aggregator Cron Job | Scheduled background job (e.g., midnight execution) to recalculate daily, weekly, and monthly novel view rankings. |
| 6 | Wallet & Payments | VNPay Payment Webhook Handler | IPN Webhook endpoint to receive and verify digital signatures (HMAC-SHA512) and credit Coins upon payment success. |
| 7 | Reader Experience | VIP Chapter Unlock Processing Service | Handles transactional logic and concurrency controls when deducting Coins to permanently unlock VIP chapters. |
| 8 | Notifications & Messages | Broadcast Notification Engine | Background service that dispatches system notifications to user mailboxes or targeted audiences. |
| 9 | System Administration | Cloudinary Asset Manager Service | Background service handling file upload, image compression, and deletion of novel covers and avatars on Cloudinary. |
| 10 | Rewards & Gamification | Daily Check-in Reset Cron Job | Scheduled cron job running at midnight to reset the daily check-in status for all active users. |

## 3\. System High Level Design {#3.-system-high-level-design}

| 07 | novel\_categories | Many-to-many relationship for multi-category classification of novels. \- **novel\_id (PK, FK)** \- category\_id (PK, FK) |
| 08 | novel\_ratings | Star rating and review system for novels. \- **id (PK)** \- novel\_id (FK) \- user\_id (FK) \- rating \- review\_text \- created\_at \- updated\_at |

| 10 | bookshelves | Reader's personal bookshelf. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- novel\_id (FK) \- added\_at |
| 11 | user\_chapter\_activities | Combines reading history, VIP unlocks, and reading progress. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- chapter\_id (FK) \- is\_read \- read\_at \- is\_unlocked \- price\_paid \- unlocked\_at |
| 12 | comments | Reader comments on chapters. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- chapter\_id (FK) \- content \- status \- created\_at \- updated\_at |

| 14 | content\_reports | Reports for content violations or chapter-level errors. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- chapter\_id (FK) \- reason \- status \- admin\_note \- resolved\_by (FK) \- created\_at \- processed\_at |
| 15 | notifications | System or personal notification inbox. \- **id (PK)** \- user\_id (FK) \- title \- content \- is\_read \- created\_at |
| 16 | coin\_packages | List of coin top-up packages. \- **id (PK)** \- name \- price \- coin\_amount \- status \- created\_at |

### 3.2 Code Packages {#3.2-code-packages}

![][image12]  
***Package descriptions***

| No | Package | Description |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | Config | Contains configuration classes used to initialize and configure the application, such as database connections, application settings, and framework configurations.  |
| 02 | Controller | Contains controller classes responsible for handling client requests, processing input, coordinating application logic, and returning appropriate responses or views.  |
| 03 | Security | Contains classes responsible for application security, including authentication, authorization, password handling, and access control.  |
| 04 | Service | Contains service classes that implement the application's business logic and coordinate operations between controllers and repositories.  |
| 05 | DTO | Contains Data Transfer Object classes used to transfer data between different layers of the application while controlling the data exposed between components.  |
| 06 | Repository | Contains repository classes responsible for accessing and managing data in the database, including querying, inserting, updating, and deleting records.  |
| 07 | Exception | Contains custom exception classes used to handle and represent application-specific errors and exceptional situations.  |
| 08 | Util | Contains utility and helper classes that provide reusable functions for common tasks used throughout the application.  |
| 09 | Entity | Contains entity classes that represent the main business objects and their corresponding data structures used by the application.  |

### 1.1 Register Account {#1.1-register-account}

| UC ID and Name: | UC-01-Register Account |  |  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| Created By: | NgocNN | Date Created: | 2026-09-19 |
| Primary Actor: | Guest | Secondary Actors: | None |
| Trigger: | Guest accesses the registration page. |  |  |
| Description: | Guest creates a new account in the system using their email and password. |  |  |
| Preconditions: | PRE-1. Guest must not be logged into the system. |  |  |
| Postconditions: | POST-1. A new account is created with PENDING\_VERIFICATION status. POST-2. An OTP verification email is sent to the provided email address. |  |  |
| Normal Flow: | A. Register Account Successfully Guest accesses the registration page. The system displays the registration form. Guest enters email, password, and confirm password. Guest clicks the "Đăng ký" button. The system validates the input data formats. The system verifies that the email does not exist in the database. The system hashes the password. The system creates a new user account with pending status. The system generates an OTP code. The system sends the OTP code to the Guest's email address. The system displays a success message. The system redirects Guest to the OTP verification page. |  |  |
| Alternative Flows: | A.5.1 Alt Invalid Input Format The system detects invalid email format or password does not meet requirements. The system displays a validation error message. Back to step 3\. A.5.2 Alt Passwords Do Not Match The system detects that the password and confirm password do not match. The system displays a validation error message. Back to step 3\. A.6.1 Alt Email Already Exists The system detects that the email is already registered. The system displays an error message indicating the email is in use. Back to step 3\. |  |  |
| Exceptions: | EX-8 Database Connection Failure The system fails to save the account due to a database error. The system displays a system error message. Back to step 1\. EX-10 Email Sending Failure The system fails to send the OTP email. The system displays an error message. Back to step 1\. |  |  |
| Priority: | High |  |  |
| Frequency of Use: | High |  |  |
| Business Rules: | BR-01 |  |  |
| Other Information: | None |  |  |
| Assumptions: | Guest has stable internet connection. |  |  |

### 3.2 Top-up Coin {#3.2-top-up-coin}

| UC ID and Name: | UC-30-Top-up Coin |  |  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| Created By: | NgocNN | Date Created: | 2026-09-19 |
| Primary Actor: | Member | Secondary Actors: | VNPay Gateway |
| Trigger: | Member accesses the top-up page. |  |  |
| Description: | Member tops up their wallet with Coin using the VNPay payment gateway. |  |  |
| Preconditions: | PRE-1. Member must be logged into the system. |  |  |
| Postconditions: | POST-1. The Coin amount is added to the Member's wallet. POST-2. A deposit transaction record is created. |  |  |
| Normal Flow: | A. Top-up Coin Successfully Member accesses the top-up page. The system displays the available top-up packages. Member selects a package and clicks the "Nạp ngay" button. The system generates a VNPay payment URL. The system redirects Member to the VNPay payment gateway. Member completes the payment on the VNPay interface. The system receives the IPN webhook response from VNPay. The system verifies the payment signature using HMAC-SHA512. The system creates a deposit transaction record. The system adds the corresponding Coin amount to the Member's wallet. The system redirects Member to the top-up result page displaying a success message. |  |  |
| Alternative Flows: | A.6.1 Alt Member Cancels Payment Member clicks the cancel button on the VNPay gateway. The system receives a cancellation redirect from VNPay. The system displays a payment cancelled message. Back to step 2\. A.8.1 Alt Invalid Signature The system detects an invalid payment signature in the webhook response. The system rejects the transaction. The system displays a payment error message. Back to step 2\. |  |  |
| Exceptions: | EX-1 Session Invalid (Not Logged In) The system displays an authentication error message. The system redirects the user to the login page. EX-9 Database Update Failure The system fails to save the transaction or update the wallet due to a database error. The system displays a system error message. Back to step 1\. |  |  |
| Priority: | High |  |  |
| Frequency of Use: | Medium |  |  |
| Business Rules: | BR-23 |  |  |
| Other Information: | None |  |  |
| Assumptions: | Member has stable internet connection. |  |  |

### 3.3 Audit Transactions   {#3.3-audit-transactions}

| UC ID and Name: | UC-51 Audit Transactions |  |  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| Created By: | KhanhND | Date Created: | 2026-09-23 |
| Primary Actor: | Admin | Secondary Actors: | None |
| Trigger: | Admin selects "Audit Transactions" under the financial management section. |  |  |
| Description: | Empowers Admin to inspect, reconcile, and audit the complete ledger of Coin balance movements across the entire platform (deposit orders via VNPay sandbox and Coin deductions for VIP chapter unlocks), matching external bank transaction IDs with IPN webhook logs to ensure financial integrity. |  |  |
| Preconditions: | PRE-1. The user is authenticated with the Admin role. |  |  |
| Postconditions: | POST-1. Admin views financial summary metrics and paginated transaction audit records. |  |  |
| Normal Flow: | A. Audit Transactions Successfully Admin navigates to the transaction audit page. The system verifies the actor's Admin authorization. The system calculates high-level financial metrics (total VNĐ deposited, total Coin issued, and total Coin consumed). The system queries deposit orders and transaction ledger records applying default pagination. The system renders summary metric cards and the audit data table (Order Code, User, Type, Amount/Coin, Status, Bank Transaction Code, Timestamp). Admin inputs search criteria or selects filter parameters (date range, transaction type, order code, user email). Admin clicks "Search" button. The system queries database records satisfying the filter criteria. The system updates the audit table with paginated filtered results. |  |  |
| Alternative Flows: | A.5 View Raw IPN Log Admin clicks "View IPN Log" button on a specific VNPay deposit record. The system queries matching raw payload records from the payment\_logs table by order code. The system displays a modal containing raw JSON response, gateway IP address, and verification status. Admin inspects audit details and clicks "Close" button. Back to step 5\. A.8 No Matching Transactions The system determines no records match the specified search filters. The system renders an empty results notification. Back to step 6\. A.9 Change Page Admin clicks a page number or "Next" , "Previous" button on pagination controls. The system calculates page offset and retrieves the requested records. The system refreshes the transaction audit table. Back to step 9\. |  |  |
| Exceptions: | EX-1 Session Invalid (Not Logged In) The system displays an authentication error message. The system redirects the user to the login page. EX-2 Access Denied The system determines the user lacks Admin privileges. The system displays a 403 Forbidden page. |  |  |
| Priority: | High, Must Have |  |  |
| Frequency of Use: | Medium |  |  |
| Business Rules: | BR-01, BR-03 |  |  |
| Other Information: | Cash refunds or balance withdrawals are strictly unsupported per platform rules. |  |  |
| Assumptions: | Admin has a stable internet connection. |  |  |

| Normal Flow: | A. View Novel List Successfully Actor accesses the homepage or a specific category page. The system retrieves the current actor's session data. The system retrieves publicly available novels based on the requested path. The system sorts the retrieved novels applying default sorting rules. The system renders the pagination controls at the bottom of the list. |  |  |

A.7 Change Page Actor clicks a specific page number, "Trang trước", or "Tiếp theo" button on the pagination controls. The system calculates the offset for the requested page. The system queries the database for the novel records on the requested page. The system updates the UI to display the new set of novels. Back to step 7\. |  |  |
| Exceptions: | EX-3 Database Connection Timeout The system fails to query the database within the expected time. The system logs the timeout error. The system displays a generic error message indicating a temporary service disruption. |  |  |
| Priority: | High, Must Have |  |  |
| Frequency of Use: | Very High |  |  |
| Business Rules: | BR-03 |  |  |

| Assumptions: | Actor has a stable internet connection. |  |  |

| Postconditions: | POST-1. The comment report ticket is created and stored in the database with a pending status. |  |  |

The system validates the target comment exists and is in a valid state. Member selects a violation reason category and inputs detailed description. Member clicks "Gửi báo cáo" button. The system validates the report reason input is not empty. The system checks that the Member has no pending report for this comment. The system saves the report record into the database with a pending status. The system closes the modal and displays a success notification message.  |  |  |
| Alternative Flows: | A.7 Invalid Reason Input The system determines the reason description is empty or exceeds length limits. The system displays an error message requesting valid reason details. The system closes the modal without saving any data.  |  |  |
| Exceptions: | EX-1 Session Invalid (Not Logged In) The system displays an authentication error message. The system redirects the user to the login page. EX-3 Target Comment Not Found The system determines the comment was deleted by its author or hidden previously. The system displays an error message indicating the comment is unavailable. The system refreshes the comment list in the UI. |  |  |

| Frequency of Use: | Medium  |  |  |

### 9.3 Resolve Reports  {#9.3-resolve-reports}

| UC ID and Name: | UC-43 Resolve Reports |  |  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| Created By: | KhanhND | Date Created: | 2026-09-23 |
| Primary Actor: | Staff, Admin | Secondary Actors: | None |
| Trigger: | Actor accesses "Quản lý báo cáo" from the administrative navigation sidebar. |  |  |
| Description: | Provides a centralized management dashboard for Staff and Admin to review reported tickets (comment reports, novel/chapter content reports), inspect violation context, execute resolution decisions (Approve with sanctions or Reject report), record audit logs, and automatically notify the reporter. |  |  |
| Preconditions: | PRE-1. The actor is authenticated with Staff or Admin role. |  |  |
| Postconditions: | POST-1. Report ticket status is transitioned to 'PROCESSED' or 'REJECTED'. POST-2. Resolution timestamp, processor ID, and administrative decision note are logged in the database. POST-3. Appropriate sanctions are applied to the violating entity (comment hidden, chapter locked, novel archived) if approved. POST-4. A notification containing resolution details is automatically sent to the reporter's notification. |  |  |
| Normal Flow: | A. Resolve Report Successfully Actor accesses the report management page. The system verifies the actor's administrative authorization. The system retrieves the list of reports from the database with pending status. The system renders the report table organized by categorized tabs, with filter and pagination controls. Actor selects a specific report record and clicks "Xem chi tiết" button. The system retrieves the detailed report ticket and the context of the reported entity. The system displays the report resolution modal with entity preview and action buttons ( "Xử lý vi phạm" , "Từ chối báo cáo" ).  Actor clicks "Xử lý vi phạm" button, enters resolution note, and selects the disciplinary sanction. Actor clicks "Xác nhận" button. The system validates the resolution note is not empty. The system executes a database transaction updating report status to 'PROCESSED', saving processor ID and resolution timestamp. The system updates the reported entity's status corresponding to the chosen disciplinary sanction. The system generates a notification dispatching the result to the reporting Member's mailbox. The system closes the modal and displays a report resolved successfully notification. |  |  |
| Alternative Flows: | A.8 Reject Report Actor clicks "Từ chối báo cáo" button, enters rejection reason, and clicks "Xác nhận"  button. The system validates rejection explanation is provided. The system updates report status to 'REJECTED', recording processor ID and resolution timestamp. The system sends an explanatory notification to the reporter's mailbox. The system closes the modal and displays a rejection completed message. Back to step 4\. A.4 Switch Tab or Apply Filters Actor clicks another tab (Comment Reports / Content Reports) or changes status filter. The system retrieves report records matching the updated criteria. The system refreshes the displayed table. Back to step 4\. A.10 Empty Resolution Note The system determines the resolution note field is blank. The system displays a validation error requiring mandatory explanation. Back to step 8\. |  |  |
| Exceptions: | EX-1 Session Invalid (Not Logged In) The system displays an authentication error message. The system redirects the user to the login page. EX-2 Access Denied The system determines the actor lacks Staff or Admin privileges. The system renders a 403 Forbidden error page. |  |  |
| Priority: | High, Must Have |  |  |
| Frequency of Use: | High (Daily) |  |  |
| Business Rules: | BR-05 |  |  |
| Other Information: | Adheres strictly to mandatory audit logging and sender notification requirements. |  |  |
| Assumptions: | Actor has a stable internet connection. |  |  |

## 12\. Rewards & Gamification {#12.-rewards-&-gamification}

### 12.1 Daily Check-in {#12.1-daily-check-in}

| UC ID and Name: | UC-32 Daily Check-in |  |  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| Created By: | TaiTP | Date Created: | 2026-09-18 |
| Primary Actor: | Member | Secondary Actors: | None |
| Trigger: | Member clicks the "Điểm danh" button on the homepage or user profile. |  |  |
| Description: | Allows a member to claim a daily reward (free Coin) once every server-day to encourage user retention. The system uses optimistic locking to ensure the reward is only claimed once per day. |  |  |
| Preconditions: | PRE-1. The user must be authenticated as a Member. |  |  |
| Postconditions: | POST-1. Free Coin is added to the member's wallet and the check-in time is recorded. |  |  |
| Normal Flow: | A. Check-in Successfully Member clicks the "Điểm danh" button. The system retrieves the current actor's session data. The system initiates a database transaction and retrieves the member's \`last\_checkin\_time\`. The system validates the current server date is strictly greater than the date of \`last\_checkin\_time\`. The system calculates the free Coin reward amount based on the current consecutive check-in streak. The system executes a database update to add the reward to the member's Coin balance and update the \`last\_checkin\_time\`. The system displays a success modal showing the amount of Coin received. |  |  |
| Alternative Flows: | A.4 Already Checked In The system determines the current server date is identical to the date of \`last\_checkin\_time\`. The system aborts the transaction. The system displays an error message indicating the member has already checked in today. Back to step 1\. |  |  |
| Exceptions: | EX-1 Session Invalid (Not Logged In) The system displays an authentication error message. The system redirects the user to the login page. EX-6 Optimistic Lock Failure The system encounters a version mismatch when committing the transaction. The system rolls back the transaction. The system displays a generic busy error message. |  |  |
| Priority: | Medium, Should Have |  |  |
| Frequency of Use: | High |  |  |
| Business Rules: | BR-22 |  |  |
| Other Information: | None |  |  |
| Assumptions: | Member has a stable internet connection. |  |  |

### 15.2 Ban/Enable User  {#15.2-ban/enable-user}

| UC ID and Name: | UC-50 Ban/Enable User |  |  |
| ----: | :---- | ----: | :---- |
| Created By: | KhanhND | Date Created: | 2026-09-23 |
| Primary Actor: | Admin | Secondary Actors: | None |
| Trigger: | Admin clicks "Khóa" or "Mở khóa" button on a specific account record in the user table. |  |  |
| Description: | Enables Admin to suspend platform access for users violating community standards (updating status to BANNED), automatically calculating progressive ban durations and invalidating active sessions; or manually restore access (status to ACTIVE) prior to ban expiry. |  |  |
| Preconditions: | PRE-1. The user is authenticated with the Admin role. PRE-2. Target user account exists in the database. |  |  |
| Postconditions: | POST-1. Target user account status is updated to BANNED or ACTIVE. POST-2. If banned, all active user sessions are terminated immediately. POST-3. An administrative audit log entry is recorded with rationale and ban expiry timestamp. |  |  |
| Normal Flow: | A. Ban User Successfully Admin clicks "Khóa" button on an offending user record. The system retrieves the current actor's session data. The system evaluates safety constraints ensuring Admin cannot ban their own account. The system queries previous violation history and ban counts for the target account. The system calculates progressive ban duration according to business rules (1st: 24h, subsequent: double previous, up to 1 year max). The system renders the ban confirmation modal with calculated duration and mandatory reason textarea. Admin reviews the duration, enters detailed violation reasons, and clicks "Xác nhận khóa tài khoản" button. The system validates the violation reason field is not empty. The system executes a database update setting status to BANNED and recording ban expiry timestamp. The system revokes all active session tokens associated with the banned account. The system creates an audit log entry detailing the ban reason and duration. The system closes the modal and displays an account banned successfully message. |  |  |
| Alternative Flows: | A.1 Enable User Before Expiry Admin clicks "Mở khóa" button on an account currently marked as BANNED. The system displays an unban confirmation modal with an unban rationale input. Admin enters justification and clicks "Xác nhận mở khóa tài khoản" button. The system updates user status to ACTIVE and clears remaining ban duration. The system logs the early unban administrative action. The system dispatches an account reactivated notification to the user's mailbox. The system refreshes the UI and displays an account restored successfully message. A.3 Self-Ban Attempt The system detects the target user is identical to the currently authenticated Admin. The system displays a warning message that you cannot ban your own account. The ban operation is aborted. A.8 Blank Ban Rationale The system detects the reason textarea is blank. The system displays a validation error requiring explicit justification. Back to step 7\. |  |  |
| Exceptions: | EX-1 Session Invalid (Not Logged In) The system displays an authentication error message. The system redirects the user to the login page. EX-2 Access Denied The system determines the user lacks Admin privileges. The system renders a 403 Forbidden page. EX-3 Target Account Not Found The system determines the target record is missing from the database. The system displays an error message and refreshes the user table. |  |  |
| Priority: | High, Must Have |  |  |
| Frequency of Use: | Medium (When severe violations occur) |  |  |
| Business Rules: | BR-04 |  |  |
| Other Information: | Implements progressive penalty scaling and permits discretionary manual early restoration by Admin. |  |  |
| Assumptions: | Admin has a stable internet connection. |  |  |

| UC ID and Name: | UC-48 Assign Roles |  |  |

| Primary Actor: | Admin | Secondary Actors: | None |
| Trigger: | Admin clicks "Phân quyền" button on a user record within the user management view. |  |  |

| Preconditions: | PRE-1. The user is authenticated with the Admin role. PRE-2. Target user account exists and is in an ACTIVE status. |  |  |
| Postconditions: | POST-1. Target user role mappings are updated in the user\_roles table. POST-2. System audit log documents the role change action performed by the Admin. POST-3. A notification informing of the role change is dispatched to the target user's mailbox. |  |  |
| Normal Flow: | A. Manage Staffs Successfully Admin clicks "Phân quyền" button on a specific user record. The system retrieves the current actor's session data. The system queries the target user's assigned roles and all system roles. The system renders the role management modal with user identity and role choices (ROLE\_MEMBER, ROLE\_STAFF). Admin selects the new role configuration to be assigned. Admin clicks "Lưu thay đổi" button. The system evaluates security constraints ensuring the Admin does not revoke their own ROLE\_ADMIN privilege. The system displays a confirmation dialog summarizing the role modification. Admin clicks "Xác nhận" button. The system executes a database transaction updating role mappings in user\_roles table. The system records an administrative audit log capturing role transition details. The system dispatches a role update notification to the target user's mailbox. The system closes the modal and displays a role updated successfully confirmation message. |  |  |
| Alternative Flows: | A.7 Self-Demotion Attempt The system detects the target user is the currently logged-in Admin and ROLE\_ADMIN was deselected. The system displays a warning message that an administrator cannot revoke their own administrator role. Back to step 4\. A.9 Cancel Confirmation Admin clicks "Hủy" button on the confirmation dialog. The system aborts the operation and closes the dialog. Back to step 4\. |  |  |
| Exceptions: | EX-1 Session Invalid (Not Logged In) The system displays an authentication error message. The system redirects the user to the login page. EX-2 Access Denied The system determines the user lacks Admin privileges. The system displays a 403 Forbidden page. EX-3 Target Account Unavailable The system determines the target user record no longer exists or is currently banned. The system displays an error message indicating invalid target account. |  |  |
| Priority: | Medium, Should Have |  |  |
| Frequency of Use: | Low (When staff assignments change)  |  |  |
| Business Rules: | None.  |  |  |
| Other Information: | Implements progressive penalty scaling and permits discretionary manual early restoration by Admin. |  |  |
| Assumptions: | Admin has a stable internet connection. |  |  |

## 3\. Discover Novels {#3.-discover-novels}

### 3.1 Discovery and Search {#3.1-discovery-and-search}

#### *a. Filter and Sort Novels*

Filter novel list by categories and status.  
Related use cases:

* UC-08\_Filter Novels

Sort novel lists by view counts, ratings, or latest updates.  
Related use cases:

* UC-09\_Sort Novels

##### **UI Design**

![][image21]

| Field Name | Field Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| \*\*\*Filters\*\*\* |  |  |
| Category Select | Multi-Choice Chips | Select one or multiple categories (e.g., Tiên hiệp, Kiếm hiệp) |
| Status Select | Single-Choice Button Group | Filter by All, ONGOING, COMPLETED |
| Access Type | Single-Choice Button Group | Filter by All, VIP, FREE |
| Chapter Count Range | Range Slider / Quick Choice Chips | Filter by min/max chapter count (e.g., 500 \- 1500 ch) |
| Min Rating | Checkbox | Filter novels with rating \>= 4.5 stars |
| Exclusive Content | Checkbox | Filter exclusive translation novels |
| \*\*\*Sort by\*\*\* |  |  |
| Sort Option | Combo Box Single-Choice | Sort options: Views, Rating, Newest |

##### **Database Access**

| Table | CRUD | Description |
| :---- | :---: | :---- |
| novels, novel\_categories | R | Query with joins |
| novels | R | Query with specific ORDER BY |

***SQL Commands***  
1/ Filter query  
SELECT DISTINCT n.id, n.title, n.cover\_url, n.views FROM novels n  
JOIN novel\_categories nc ON n.id \= nc.novel\_id  
WHERE nc.category\_id IN (?) AND n.status \= COALESCE(?, n.status) AND n.is\_deleted \= FALSE;

2/ Sorted Query  
SELECT id, title, cover\_url, views, average\_rating, updated\_at FROM novels  
WHERE status IN ('ONGOING', 'COMPLETED') AND is\_deleted \= FALSE  
ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT ?;

***SQL Commands***

SELECT c.id, c.content, c.created\_at, u.full\_name, u.avatar\_url FROM comments c  
JOIN users u ON c.user\_id \= u.id  
WHERE c.chapter\_id \= ? AND c.status \= 'VISIBLE' ORDER BY c.created\_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?;

2/ Insert Comment  
INSERT INTO comments (user\_id, chapter\_id, content) VALUES (?, ?, ?);

##### 

##### **Database Access**

| Table | CRUD | Description |
| :---- | :---: | :---- |
| novel\_ratings | CU | Insert or update rating |
| novels | U | Update average rating cache |

***SQL Commands***  
1/ Save Rating  
INSERT INTO novel\_ratings (novel\_id, user\_id, rating, review\_text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)  
ON CONFLICT (novel\_id, user\_id) DO UPDATE SET rating \= EXCLUDED.rating, review\_text \= EXCLUDED.review\_text, updated\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP;

2/ Update average rating  
UPDATE novels SET average\_rating \= (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM novel\_ratings WHERE novel\_id \= ?),  
rating\_count \= (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM novel\_ratings WHERE novel\_id \= ?) WHERE id \= ?;

***SQL Commands:***

1/ Deduct user coins  
UPDATE users SET wallet\_balance \= wallet\_balance \- ? WHERE id \= ? AND wallet\_balance \>= ?;  
2/ Record chapter unlock  
INSERT INTO user\_chapter\_activities (user\_id, chapter\_id, is\_unlocked, price\_paid, unlocked\_at)  
VALUES (?, ?, TRUE, ?, CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP)  
ON CONFLICT (user\_id, chapter\_id) DO UPDATE SET is\_unlocked \= TRUE, price\_paid \= ?, unlocked\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP;  
3/ Log transaction  
INSERT INTO transactions (user\_id, amount, balance\_after, type, reference\_id, description)  
VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'UNLOCK\_CHAPTER', ?, 'Unlocked VIP Chapter');

#### *d. Save Reading Progress*

This function automatically calculates novel reading percentage and updates the reader's latest chapter bookmark.

Related use cases:

* UC-27 Save Reading Progress

##### **UI Design**

![][image30]

| Field Name | Field Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| \*\*\*Reading Status Bar\*\*\* |  |  |
| Reading Percentage | Text | Calculated percentage of chapters completed (e.g. "Chapter 25 / 100 (25%)") |
| Bookmark Icon | icon | Active bookmark indicating latest reading position |
| Auto-save Indicator | Text | Background badge showing "Progress saved" |

##### **Database Access**

| Table | CRUD | Description |
| :---- | :---: | :---- |
| chapters | R | Count total published chapters in novel to compute reading percentage |
| user\_chapter\_activities | CRU | Upsert member's reading position with timestamp and read flag |

SQL Commands:  
1/ Count total published chapters in novel to compute reading percentage  
SELECT COUNT(c.id) AS total\_chapters,  
       COUNT(uca.chapter\_id) AS read\_chapters  
FROM chapters c  
LEFT JOIN user\_chapter\_activities uca ON c.id \= uca.chapter\_id AND uca.user\_id \= ? AND uca.is\_read \= TRUE  
WHERE c.novel\_id \= ? AND c.status IN ('PUBLISHED\_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED\_VIP') AND c.is\_deleted \= FALSE;  
2/ Upsert member's reading position with timestamp and read flag  
INSERT INTO user\_chapter\_activities (user\_id, chapter\_id, is\_read, read\_at)  
VALUES (?, ?, TRUE, CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP)  
ON CONFLICT (user\_id, chapter\_id)  
DO UPDATE SET is\_read \= TRUE, read\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP;

#### *b. Top-up Coin*

Process payment via VNPay gateway and automatically credit coins to the wallet.

Related use cases:

* UC-30 Top-up Coin

##### **UI Design**

![][image46]

| Field Name | Field Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| \*\*\*Header Information\*\*\* |  |  |
| Top-up Rules Text | Text | Displays conversion rate and coin validity policy |
| Current Balance Badge | Badge | Displays user's current coin balance |
| \*\*\*Package Selection\*\*\* |  |  |
| Coin Package Cards | Radio Button Group | Selectable cards showing Coin amount, Price (VND), and Bonus/Tags |
| Important Note | Text | Warning regarding non-refundable policy |
| \*\*\*Payment Actions\*\*\* |  |  |
| Total Payable Amount | Text | Displays total VND to pay and total Coins to receive |
| Pay via VNPay Button | Button | Generates order and redirects to VNPay gateway for payment |
| Footer Trust Badges | Text | Displays SSL security and support contact info |

##### **Database Access**

| Table | CRUD | Description |
| :---- | ----- | :---- |
| coin\_packages | R | Retrieve active coin packages list |
| topup\_orders | CRU | Create pending order and update status upon receiving VNPay IPN |
| payment\_logs | C | Store raw VNPay IPN response payload for debugging and verification |
| users | RU | Update wallet\_balance upon successful payment verification |
| transactions | C | Record TOPUP\_COIN balance fluctuation |

***SQL Commands:***

1/ Retrieve active coin packages list  
SELECT id, name, price, coin\_amount FROM coin\_packages WHERE status \= 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY price ASC;

2/ Create pending order and update status upon receiving VNPay IPN  
INSERT INTO topup\_orders (user\_id, package\_id, order\_code, amount\_vnd, coin\_received, status, payment\_method)  
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', 'VNPAY');

UPDATE topup\_orders  
SET status \= 'SUCCESS', bank\_transaction\_code \= ?, paid\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP, updated\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP  
WHERE order\_code \= ? AND status \= 'PENDING';

3/ Store raw VNPay IPN response payload for debugging and verification  
INSERT INTO payment\_logs (order\_code, raw\_payload, ip\_address, status)  
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?);

4/ Update wallet\_balance upon successful payment verification  
UPDATE users SET wallet\_balance \= wallet\_balance \+ ?, updated\_at \= CURRENT\_TIMESTAMP  
WHERE id \= ? RETURNING wallet\_balance;  
5/ Record TOPUP\_COIN balance fluctuation  
INSERT INTO transactions (user\_id, amount, balance\_after, type, reference\_id, description)  
VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'TOPUP\_COIN', ?, ?);

VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'GIFT\_COIN', ?, 'Daily check-in reward');

# IV. Appendix {#iv.-appendix}

## 1\. Assumptions & Dependencies {#1.-assumptions-&-dependencies}

AS-1:	Users (Guest, Member, Staff, Admin) have a stable internet connection and use modern web browsers to access the system.

AS-2:	The Staff and Admin team will be responsible for moderating copyright and the quality of novel content before publishing it on the platform.

DE-1:	The system depends on third-party payment gateways (VNPay, Momo Sandbox) to process users' Coin top-up transactions.

DE-2:	Google OAuth2 integration is required to support the quick Social Login feature for users.

DE-3:	The project relies on Cloudinary for storing and delivering image assets (novel covers, user avatars).

DE-4:	The system requires a Mail Server service (e.g., Gmail SMTP) to handle sending emails containing OTP codes for account verification and password reset.

## 2\. Limitations & Exclusions {#2.-limitations-&-exclusions}

LI-1:	Mobile Application: The system is solely a Web-based platform (using Spring MVC and Thymeleaf). Dedicated mobile applications (iOS/Android Mobile Apps) are not within the development scope of this project.

LI-2:	Withdraw/Refund: Coins topped up into the system by users can only be used to unlock VIP chapters and cannot be converted back to cash, withdrawn, or refunded under any circumstances.

LI-3:	User-generated content: Regular members do not have the right to create and upload their own novels. Adding and publishing content is entirely managed by Staff/Admin.

LI-4:	Comic/Manga support: Trạm Truyện currently only supports purely text-based novel formats and does not support image-based comic/manga formats.

LI-5:	SPA Architecture: In the main version, the system's Frontend does not adopt the SPA (Single Page Application) architecture or fully separate REST APIs, but instead uses a Server-side Rendering mechanism.

LI-6:	Audio Reader quality: The voice reading feature (Audio Reader) depends on the default Text-to-Speech Engine of the user's browser/operating system, thus the voice quality may vary across different devices.

## 3\. Business Rules {#3.-business-rules}

| ID | Category | Rule Definition |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| BR-01 | Constraints | Account Security: Password must be hashed using BCrypt. Reset tokens must have an expiration time. |
| BR-02 | Constraints | Novel Titles: Duplicate novel titles by the same author are prevented. |
| BR-03 | Constraints | Novel Status: ONGOING is the default initial status. The public interface strictly limits visibility to ONGOING and COMPLETED status. |
| BR-04 | Constraints | Novel Deletion: A novel is never physically deleted (soft deletion). ON\_HOLD novels must be strictly excluded from public lists. |
| BR-05 | Constraints | Chapter Management: Only Staff and Admin may create, update, delete (soft delete), lock/unlock, or configure chapters. Chapters with existing purchases cannot be permanently deleted, only soft-deleted (status \= archived/hidden). |
| BR-06 | Constraints | VIP Chapters: A VIP chapter must have a positive Coin price. A regular published chapter does not require a Coin price. |
| BR-07 | Constraints | Category Uniqueness: Category name and URL slug must be unique system-wide. Slug must conform to standard URL format. |
| BR-08 | Constraints | Category Deletion: Cannot delete a category if the associated novel count \> 0\. Admin must detach category from all novels before deletion. |
| BR-09 | Constraints | Category Mapping: Each novel must have a minimum of 1 category and a maximum of 5 categories. Mapping updates must be in a single transaction block. |
| BR-10 | Computations | Category Counts: Publicly displayed novel counts per category only include published novels (ONGOING, COMPLETED). |
| BR-11 | Constraints | Chapter Visibility: Draft or locked chapters are not displayed to Guests/Members. VIP chapters must be visually distinct in the chapter list. |
| BR-12 | Constraints | VIP Access: Guest actors cannot bypass VIP locks. Audio playback is only available for chapters the user is already authorized to access. |
| BR-13 | Computations | Reading Progress: Progress tracking is strictly reserved for authenticated Members. The completion percentage is dynamically calculated. |
| BR-14 | Facts | Reading History: The reading history list is capped at a maximum of 50 recent entries. Only the latest timestamp is preserved per chapter. |
| BR-15 | Facts | Bookshelf: Bookshelf sorting defaults to the most recently read novel at the top. Removing a novel from the bookshelf also deletes its reading progress bookmark. |
| BR-16 | Computations | Leaderboards: Leaderboard updates exclusively count valid view records. Rankings are cached periodically for query optimization. |
| BR-17 | Computations | Ratings: Each Member is restricted to 1 rating record per novel. Subsequent submissions overwrite previous rating. Average rating score is total stars / total reviews, rounded to 1 decimal place. |
| BR-18 | Constraints | Comments: Comment length must be between 50 and 500 characters. |
| BR-19 | Constraints | Hidden Comments: Comments hidden or soft-deleted by Staff/Admin (is\_deleted \= true) are excluded from public views. |
| BR-20 | Constraints | Transactions: Balance deductions MUST occur within an ACID-compliant transaction using pessimistic locking. |
| BR-21 | Facts | VIP Permanence: Once unlocked, a VIP chapter is permanently accessible to that specific user ID without repurchase. |
| BR-22 | Facts | Daily Check-in: Check-in reset time is governed by the server's time zone. Check-in rewards cannot be withdrawn or converted to fiat currency. |
| BR-23 | Facts | Coin Top-ups: Coin top-up payments are non-refundable and cannot be converted to fiat currency. |
| BR-24 | Facts | Search & Filter: Search is case-insensitive. Selecting multiple categories applies combination logic. Pagination state and filters are preserved during sorting. |
